title: The Deal
author: Elle Kennedy
summary: A college hockey star agrees to tutor a clever, guarded classmate who needs to make another guy jealous. In return, he gets help passing a class he can't afford to fail, and the arrangement stops being purely practical.
readIf: you want a campus hockey romance with heat, banter and a heroine working through something painful.
skipIf: you want a purely light read, since it deals directly with an assault in the heroine's past.

pairings.reason: Another college hockey romance, newer and a little more tender, with a similar mix of heat and humour.
A fake-relationship romance with a stern, secretly caring hero and a steady slow thaw.
Both treat serious relationship trauma inside a love story, though this one is far heavier and more painful.
